ops.oldText: is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
ops.newText: is limited to the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by IBM to MSL under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the action and (b) one million U.S. dollars (US$1,000,000). This limitation does not apply to Excluded Claims, which means a Party's indemnification obligations under this Agreement, a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, a Party's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, a Party's infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights, and IBM's obligation to pay amounts properly due under this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We reset the mutual cap to the greater of twelve months' charges and US$1,000,000, because 3% of bill-of-materials value is well below our minimum of twelve months' fees. We also added the standard carve-outs so indemnification, confidentiality/security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, together with IBM's payment obligations.
input.summary: Replace 3%-of-BOM cap with mutual greater-of 12 months' charges / US$1m cap and add uncapped Excluded Claims carve-outs.
